title: A Oath for the Choir
author: Zephyrine Pemberton
blurb: Kestrel Dravenmoor, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
